scope: Cognigrex.cgx parent identity, LOAD.cgx Alexandria alias, cross-family references
observed_gap: The current draft LOAD reader opens ZIP and parses library/one_of_one.json, checking only duplicate ref_id values. It does not call native carrier manifest/content-root/DBR verification or enforce authenticated Object_ID binding. Treat all results as untrusted source references until native checks are independently verified.

cases.input: Existing canonical Object_ID matches a candidate LOAD source alias but source identity/owner hash is unresolved
cases.expected: HOLD_COLLISION; no new Object_ID or automatic alias binding

cases.input: Two LOAD entries have different ref_id but the same alias
cases.expected: AMBIGUOUS; no first-match authority; current draft resolve() returns AMBIGUOUS for matching aliases

cases.input: Same provider source ID referenced by Romer.cgx and Eco.cgx
cases.expected: SHARED_SOURCE_REFERENCE; do not duplicate source authority or child-owned state

cases.input: Same title and URI, distinct source hashes or time epochs
LifeSpace legacy term and LS.cgx/LightSpeed name resemble one another
cases.expected: NO_EQUIVALENCE until original source ID, semantics and owner verified

cases.input: CCC historical mint-pack/ERC money record compared to CGX Object_ID mint operation
cases.expected: DISTINCT_TYPED_FUNCTIONS; financial action DENIED without independent authorization

cases.input: Romer/Eco/EMASSC relation registry extends qualifier /0.1 while current shared contract declares /0.2
cases.expected: SCHEMA_COMPATIBILITY_HOLD until explicit version crosswalk and negative tests

cases.input: Arbitrary ZIP contains library/one_of_one.json but has no valid CGX native manifest or DBR root
cases.expected: REJECT_NATIVE_CARRIER; draft load_reader.py does not enforce this; acceptance gate remains HOLD

cases.input: Source locator exists but R0 source bytes/hash/ACL not verified
cases.expected: REFERENCE_ONLY; do not upgrade to R1 or native admitted

cases.input: Unauthenticated or self-reported DBR receipt, no receiver readback
cases.expected: NO_CANONICAL_WRITE; do not claim accepted or live installed

cases.input: LOAD.cgx offline H0-H3 reference resolves to a capability without signed execution lease
cases.expected: H4_EXECUTION_DENIED; qualified capability description is not runtime permission

cases.input: Cross-domain CORRESPONDS_TO asserted without registry namespace or owner/evidence qualifiers
cases.expected: FRONTIER; not SAME_AS; no endpoint authority transfer
